//: Loaded by 'dotnet run -- --variant kv'. Everything the default mode reads from secrets.d / inline config comes from Azure Key Vault instead, through the stock configuration provider (Program.cs). The vault endpoint itself comes from the environment (KeyVault__Uri) — deliberately NOT declared here, so the exported value is never shadowed; 'dotnet run -- --variant kv' without it fails fast naming KeyVault:Uri. Vault object names ARE config keys: a certificate (or secret) named CredProx--Secrets--adpClientCert lands as CredProx:Secrets:adpClientCert. The provider never polls unless ReloadIntervalSeconds is set — it is here. --kv-smoke replays this exact code path against a loopback stub.
